title: Onboard the five waiting agents on fresh worktrees, with swarm readiness checkable
goal: cursor, claude, devin, codex and antigravity are waiting, but every worktree they could resume in is 107-319 commits behind origin/main (claim refuses from a stale tree), two of them resolve their identity to the shared INTELLIBITZ token, and codex's holds 7 unpushed commits plus 8 dirty files. Verify and provision what a ready swarm needs: one fresh worktree per agent off latest origin/main with a unique susi.agent, hooks installed, a clean tree; at least one dependency-ready unclaimed task for each; and nothing lost from the old trees. Write scripts/check-swarm-readiness.py so this is repeatable: per-agent readiness, the claimable queue, and a warning for any worktree still holding unlanded work. Acceptance: the checker reports every roster agent ready.
